subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson application, Marc Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Civil Engineering Draftsperson
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role for Sungold Solar's solar and renewable energy projects, advertised on SEEK. Of the drawings the ad describes, earthworks, grading and drainage are what my diploma covered; site layouts, footings and equipment pads for solar farms I would be learning.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026, the qualification your ad names. In the coursework I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries so the designs worked around existing services. I also modelled a footing and column in AutoCAD 3D and a pedestrian truss bridge in Revit. My Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) covered structural principles and construction methods.

On site in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, ran inspections and quality checks, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers, so I read drawings from the builder's side as well as the drafter's.

To be plain about experience: my drafting is from the diploma, not a paid drafting role, so I would be starting at the junior end and learning your standards. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to walk you through them.

screening_answers.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
screening_answers.answer: I hold a Subclass 485 visa with full working rights until December 2027.

screening_answers.question: What's your expected annual base salary?
screening_answers.answer: [Marc to confirm. The SEEK header shows $80,000 to $90,000 per year; the ad body says $80,000 plus super.]

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
screening_answers.answer: No paid drafting years yet. Two years of design and drafting coursework in AutoCAD and Civil 3D through the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (2024 to 2026), plus Revit modelling.

screening_answers.question: How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil construction?
screening_answers.answer: Yes: Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2026) and Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

screening_answers.question: Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
screening_answers.answer: Yes: reviewing structural and architectural drawings on site in the Philippines (2019 to 2020) and preparing and reviewing civil drawings in the diploma.

checklist: Open https://www.seek.com.au/job/94911522 and use Apply (the SEEK advertiser is PlusJob; the employer named in the ad is Sungold Solar).
Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Paste the screening answers above and fill the two placeholders.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: Agency posting (PlusJob) with a named employer (Sungold Solar); no direct contact research because agencies are not used as contacts. The ad names the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design as an accepted qualification.
